decision: Not accepted: the clean A/B/A does not distinguish a >=0.5ms full-frame net gain from control drift. Revert candidate production; retain candidate commit and evidence. No follow-up tuning.
scope: Synthetic held-health 15-enemy full-view QA. True speed 1, 60Hz fixed battle, uncapped/VSync 0, GPU contacts and retained flights on, stat cache on, saves off. Same engine/DLL and fixture. No Godot/native rebuild.
allowed_behavior_difference: Independent decorative translation/rotation removed; entry, logical movement, turret aim and carrier orbits retained. Travel paths and impact timing change. B has 3 additional hit/impact events at the endpoint; no attack-rate or damage/drop formula reduction. This is not canonical-state equality against the moving baseline.
state_comparison: A1/A2 canonical kernel equal except RNG seed metadata; RNG state equal. A/B differences in flight geometry/timing, target shield-hit times and a defensive buffer; no equality claim.
counter_notes: Missing static counter means zero executions. Counts runs are separate instrumented diagnostics, not acceptance timings. Their frame counts differ; logical steps are exactly 480. B still rebuilds at configuration boundaries.
files: run.py reuses current-frame CPU sampler and presentation-strip mode-zero gate, with exact Git source overlays. proposed-tests.patch applies to the baseline test file for candidate-specific assertions. Raw runs are gzip JSON; screenshots retain complete UI.
limits: No natural-save, long-run or broad gameplay claim. The >=0.5ms full-frame acceptance threshold is not met with distinguishable evidence.
